# Coolors

> Coolors is a super fast color palette generator and comprehensive design toolkit for creating, exploring, and optimizing colors for web and UI design.

Coolors provides an integrated suite of AI-powered color tools including palette generation, contrast checking, image color extraction, and gradient creation. The platform supports multiple frameworks like Tailwind CSS and offers extensions for Chrome and iOS, making it accessible across design workflows.

## Key Topics

- Color Palette Generator
- AI-Powered Color Suggestions
- Contrast Checker
- Color Picker
- Palette Visualizer
- Gradient Maker
- Image Color Extraction
- Accessibility Compliance
- Tailwind CSS Integration
- Color Bot
- SVG Recoloring
- WCAG Standards
- Design Tools
- Color Accessibility
- Figma Integration

## Core Color Tools

- [Create a Palette](https://coolors.co/generate): Core palette generator with AI-powered color creation and accessibility tools
- [Color Picker](https://coolors.co/color-picker): Analyze colors with blindness simulation, harmonies, and format conversion
- [Color Bot](https://coolors.co/color-bot): AI-powered chat interface for intelligent color suggestions and exploration
- [Explore Color Palettes](https://coolors.co/palettes): Browse thousands of color palette schemes for design inspiration
- [Color Library](https://coolors.co/colors): Browse 800+ colors organized by shade with accessibility features

## Accessibility & Quality Tools

- [Color Contrast Checker](https://coolors.co/contrast-checker): Check WCAG contrast compliance for text and background colors
- [Palette Visualizer](https://coolors.co/visualizer): Preview color palettes on actual UI designs and templates

## Gradient Tools

- [Create a Gradient](https://coolors.co/gradient-maker): Generate and export custom gradients with CSS export capability
- [Browse Gradients](https://coolors.co/gradients): Explore beautiful gradient designs for UI and web projects
- [Create a Gradient Palette](https://coolors.co/gradient-palette): Create gradient palettes between two colors for design projects

## Image & Visual Tools

- [Extract Palette from Image](https://coolors.co/image-picker): Extract color palettes from photos using image color extraction
- [Image Recolor](https://coolors.co/image-recolor): Recolor SVG images to match your custom color palettes
- [Image Converter](https://coolors.co/image-converter): Bulk convert images between PNG, JPG, GIF and other formats
- [Create a Collage](https://coolors.co/collage-maker): Create collages combining photos and color palettes with customization

## Framework & Design Integration

- [Tailwind Colors](https://coolors.co/tailwind): Explore and preview Tailwind CSS color palette with export options

## Typography & Fonts

- [Fonts](https://coolors.co/fonts): Browse hundreds of free fonts for typography and design projects
- [Font Generator](https://coolors.co/font-generator): Generate custom styled fonts for social media and design applications

## Account & Home

- [Home](https://coolors.co): Main homepage showcasing Coolors color palette generator and design tools
- [User Dashboard](https://coolors.co/user): User dashboard for managing saved palettes and design projects
